doc: Hand-derived from size.tscn and the engine's stretch rules, not measured (README.md 'Expected'). pre_arm: the headless root window is the 64x64 SceneTree minimum (scene_tree.cpp:2035); under canvas_items/expand the stretch scale is min(64/640, 64/360) = 0.1, so the visible rect is the 64x64 window's aspect at logical width, 640x640, and font oversampling is 0.1 (viewport.cpp:1064-1101). post_arm: Window.set_min_size(640,360) makes the window the logical size: scale 1, visible 640x360, oversampling 1. items: Size, Back, Corner, Edge, Title, Note, all adopted. strict: size-before-adopt under strict is the pre-existing-object failure of the first hooked call that names an unadopted RID.
